name: @zvndev/darkmown
description: Darkmown — the markdown framework. Plain .md stays plain; rename to .wd for loops, state, includes, and tiny reactive islands. Zero JS on static pages.

scripts.runtime:size: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),zlib=require('zlib'); const size=zlib.gzipSync(fs.readFileSync('dist/__wd/runtime.js')).length; console.log('shipped runtime gzipped: '+size+' bytes (budget: 5120)'); if (size >= 5120) process.exit(1)"
scripts.test:extension: npm --prefix editors/vscode ci && npm --prefix editors/vscode test
scripts.prepublish:check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:cov && npm run build && npm run runtime:size && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run smoke
